applies_to: go-eCharger models covered by the go-eCharger API v2 repository (Modbus page on the main branch); the byte-order fix noted for firmware 60.4 applies.
summary: go-eCharger wallboxes on the v2 API expose a Modbus TCP server on port 502 once it is enabled in the app or over the HTTP API. This map covers the single-register status and control points: charging state, errors, charge permission, access mode, cable lock, current setpoints, push-button current levels, phase switch mode and force state.

addressing.note: The table prints each register as Modicon number plus wire address, e.g. '40300 (299)' and '30101 (100)'. The number in brackets goes in the request PDU.

notes: Official go-e documentation hosted in the goecharger GitHub organisation.

Left out: all 32-bit and 64-bit values (voltages, currents, power, energy, power factor, ENERGY_LIMIT, RFID card energies). Their word order depends on the charger's 'modbus slave swap registers/bytes' settings (msr/msb) and no default is stated.

Left out: input rows printed only as a bare number (132, 144-159, 200-205, 301-322) because the table does not mark which convention they use, and ASCII/binary blocks (firmware version, MAC, serial, host name, network, RFID).
The source notes that byte order was swapped in firmware 60.3 and fixed in 60.4.
API keys psm (phase switch mode) and frc (force state) are described in the repository's API_KEYS_FIRMWARE/apikeys-en.md; only frc's values are spelled out there.
The v2 Modbus page does not state a unit ID; the older v1 document gives unit 1.
The v2 Modbus page does not list which charger models it covers.

registers.name: CAR_STATE
registers.description: Charging state as seen on the PWM pilot.

registers.name: PP_CABLE
registers.description: Type 2 cable current coding: 13-32 A, 0 = no cable.

registers.name: ERROR
registers.description: Error code.

registers.name: ALLOW
registers.description: Whether the PWM charging signal is allowed.

registers.name: ACCESS_STATE
registers.description: Access control mode.

registers.description: 0 = off, 255 = maximum.

registers.description: LEDs switch off automatically after 10 s when on.

registers.name: AMPERE_MAX
registers.description: Upper limit for the current setting.

registers.name: AMPERE_L1
registers.description: Push-button current level 1: 6-32 A, 0 = skipped.

registers.name: AMPERE_L2
registers.description: Push-button current level 2: 6-32 A, 0 = skipped.

registers.name: AMPERE_L3
registers.description: Push-button current level 3: 6-32 A, 0 = skipped.

registers.name: AMPERE_L4
registers.description: Push-button current level 4: 6-32 A, 0 = skipped.

registers.name: AMPERE_L5
registers.description: Push-button current level 5: 6-32 A, 0 = skipped.

registers.name: NORWAY_MODE
registers.description: Disables ground detection; for IT networks only.

registers.name: AMPERE_VOLATILE
registers.description: Charge current 6-32 A, not saved; use for energy management.

registers.description: Charge current 6-32 A, saved to EEPROM (about 100,000 writes).

registers.name: PHASE_SWITCH_MODE
registers.description: Same as API key psm; accepts 0, 1 or 2 (firmware 55.5+).

registers.name: FORCE_STATE
registers.description: Same as API key frc (firmware 55.6+).

integration.summary: Enable Modbus, then connect to TCP port 502. Read CAR_STATE (100) and ERROR (107), allow charging with ALLOW (200) and set the current with AMPERE_VOLATILE (299) for dynamic load management, writing with function 16.
integration.enable: Turn on Modbus in the app (Internet tab > Advanced Settings > Modbus) or with the HTTP API key men=true, e.g. /api/set?men=true. The port is set with msp (reboot needed).
quirks: Writes must use function 16 even for one register; function 06 is not implemented.
Word and byte order of multi-register values follow the msr/msb settings.
setup: Enable Modbus in the app or via the HTTP API (men=true).
Default port 502 after enabling; change with msp and reboot.
gotchas: Use AMPERE_VOLATILE (299) for frequent changes; AMPERE_EEPROM (300) is stored in EEPROM with roughly 100,000 write cycles.
AMPERE_VOLATILE resets to the stored EEPROM value at the next boot.

address_note: address = 0-based Modbus wire (PDU) address; documented = as printed in the source.
note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source) and verified against it. Registers vary by firmware and options; verify against the live device before writing.
